JD Sports Appoints New Marketing Chief, Americas Boss
JD Sports Fashion named a new marketing chief and a new leader for its North America division, looking to boost growth and strengthen its presence in the region.
The British retailer named Mike Grimes as group chief marketing officer, who previously worked as marketing boss for the North America business.

The company, which sells brands including Nike and Adidas, also appointed John Mersho as president and chief executive of the North American division. Mersho, who held the role of chief commercial officer for the business since 2025, replaces John Hall, who retired.

The appointments, both with immediate effect, reflect JD's focus on capturing the "significant growth opportunity" it sees in North America, the company said Tuesday. The region is JD's largest market and represented 38% of group sales in fiscal 2026, ended Jan. 31.

"These appointments represent an important step in the next phase of JD's growth," Chief Executive Regis Schultz said Tuesday. "John and Mike are outstanding leaders - both well-tenured within our business, bringing extensive experience and deep knowledge of the markets we operate in."
